Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor

summary.intent: Turn Flow on for the error tests and jsutils inspect test, and let the `GraphQLError` constructor declaration accept `null` nodes (spec: PR text for graphql-js#1582).
summary.issue_fit: Issue alignment unavailable (no originating issue); judged against the supplied PR text and the commit message. Typing goals met by the diff; the test rewrite in the PR body drops coverage of one case.
summary.coverage: All 5 changed files read in full from the merge-base diff. `GraphQLError-test.js` run once at head: 13 passing. Mutation check in a scratch copy (fallback stack branches removed): base test file fails the no-stack test, head file passes it. `flow check` and lint were not run (outside the run allowance).
coverage_gaps: `flow check` was not run (not within the execution allowance), so whether the newly `@flow strict` test files type-check is unverified; a Flow run at head could surface type errors in any of the four test files.

findings.title: Keep the no-stack test on an error without a stack
findings.trigger: `creates new stack if original error has no stack` now passes `new Error('original')`, which has a stack, so `GraphQLError` takes the `originalError.stack` branch instead of the no-stack case.
findings.impact: The falsy-`originalError.stack` case has no test; for example, changing the condition at `GraphQLError.js:195` to `if (originalError)` would leave the suite green (the test at head duplicates `uses the stack of an original error`).
findings.change: In `src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js`, keep an original without a stack, e.g. `const original: any = { message: 'original' };` (the `: any` pattern the PR uses in `locatedError-test.js`).
findings.source: PR body: the change is made only "so the file type-checks".

observations.fact: The declared constructor now accepts `null` nodes, but the implementation signature `nodes?: $ReadOnlyArray<ASTNode> | ASTNode | void` still omits `null`.

requirements.evidence: src/error/GraphQLError.js:26 adds `| null` to `nodes`; the run-time code already handles null (`nodes ? [nodes] : undefined`). Reviewer comment on nodes/null is addressed by this line.

requirements.source: pr-title/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"
requirements.evidence: The four test files switch to `@flow strict`; `flow check` was not runnable within the allowance. Mocha at head: 13 passing for GraphQLError-test.js.
The `new Error('original')` swap serves type-checking but removes the no-stack case from the test named for it (error/no-stack-test-untested).
